before.label: Adding a record preserves earlier records

after.label: Adding the exact new record preserves every earlier record

before.label: Report contains one row per user
before.expression: SELECT COUNT(*)=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)=2 FROM report

before.label: Known values average correctly
before.expression: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM report WHERE user_id='a' AND row_count=2 AND known_count=2 AND average_minutes=30

before.label: Unknown minutes are not treated as zero
before.expression: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM report WHERE user_id='b' AND row_count=2 AND known_count=1 AND average_minutes=10

after.label: Report contains one row per user
after.expression: SELECT COUNT(*)=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)=2 FROM report

after.label: Known values average correctly
after.expression: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM report WHERE user_id='a' AND row_count=2 AND known_count=2 AND average_minutes=30

after.label: Unknown minutes are not treated as zero
after.expression: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM report WHERE user_id='b' AND row_count=2 AND known_count=1 AND average_minutes=10

after.label: The named report is a view, not a replacement table
after.expression: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='view' AND name='report'

before.label: All orders count, but only paid amounts contribute
before.expression: SELECT count(*)=1 FROM customer_orders WHERE customer_id=1 AND name='Alex' AND total_orders=3 AND paid_orders=2 AND paid_cents=1750

before.label: A customer with no orders stays with zero totals
before.expression: SELECT count(*)=1 FROM customer_orders WHERE customer_id=2 AND total_orders=0 AND paid_orders=0 AND paid_cents=0

before.label: Matching names remain separate and unpaid orders stay unpaid
before.expression: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM customer_orders)=3 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM customer_orders WHERE customer_id=3 AND name='Alex' AND total_orders=2 AND paid_orders=0 AND paid_cents=0)=1

after.label: All orders count, but only paid amounts contribute
